units.function: Pure self-tests for the plugin-sdk environment driver harness, fake provider, lifecycle event recorder/assertions and configurable failure behavior.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> plugin-sdk testing harness and fake environment driver -> in-memory events/logs/state; no server runtime, database, provider process, network, filesystem, Secret store or real Connector is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Plugin manifest/API version/capability, driver key, company/environment/Run inputs, provider lease, workspace, execute result and ordered environment lifecycle/error events.
units.lifecycle: Instantiate manifest and fake driver -> validate/probe -> acquire -> realize -> execute one or more commands -> release or destroy/resume -> inspect event order/errors/logs through reusable assertions.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 13/13. The suite is fast and covers more lifecycle stages than the server contract, but remains a self-referential fake-driver test. It omits independent implementations, compatibility versions, cancellation/streaming/timeouts, concurrency/idempotency, cleanup failures, privacy, Secret/data policy, approval/evidence and attestation.
units.designRationale: Give plugin authors a hermetic way to exercise environment hooks and assert lifecycle ordering before connecting a real infrastructure provider.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs one canonical Connector SDK conformance framework that vendors and enterprise teams can run locally and in certification pipelines without real production credentials or data.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT this harness as the single conformance-kit foundation. Add independent reference Connectors, version/capability matrices, deterministic clock/IDs, stream/pause/approval/resume/cancel/timeout/idempotency/concurrency, failure/recovery, Secret handles, DataAuthorization/egress, evidence/result/run attestation, privacy guards and explicit PASS/SKIP/INFRA_ERROR reports.
units.responsibilityConflict: Recorded company/Run values are not checked against goal initiator, executing Agent, accountable human, approval or data contract. A driver can pass lifecycle ordering while violating the responsibility chain and leaking sensitive event payloads.
units.securityFindings: HIGH self-conformance gap: only the SDK fake driver is tested. HIGH lifecycle gap: cancel/timeout/stream/pause/approval and cleanup failures are absent. HIGH payload-privacy gap: no guard prevents credentials, commands, data or error text entering harness events/logs. HIGH responsibility/evidence/attestation gap. MEDIUM compatibility gap: no multi-version manifest/SDK fixtures.
